title: Reversed Water
description: Something is going on with this water, it seems to reverses any damage to living entities..
body:
Reversed Water only found in The End. Not sure how it works, but it seems to reverse any damage done to any living entities, including any negative status effects.

- **Heals living entities** — half a heart-beat every second while submerged. Players, villagers, hostile mobs, your dog. The water doesn't pick favorites.
- **Extinguishes fire** — step in it on fire, walk out not on fire. No animation, no waiting.
- **Purges harmful effects** — every Poison, Wither, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, and friends gets stripped on the next heal tick. Step out of a witch fight, into a Reversed Water pool, and walk away clean.
- **Behaves like water for everything else** — boats float, you can swim and dive, Frost Walker freezes it, Riptide works in it, the Nether destroys it on placement, lava contact gives you cobble/stone/obsidian per the usual rules.

Bring a chorus fruit back from The End. Drop it beside a water bucket on the crafting grid(shapeless recipe). Pour it in a source block or waterfall fashion. Stand in it and watch the magic happen.

Plays nicely with vanilla water — they're separate fluids. They don't merge, they don't replace each other. You can have both pools side by side.

Feedback

Let me know via Discord if you have any feedback!

If you really like the mod and would like to donate, it would be greatly appreciated!

I prefer making mods that actually bring something new to the table rather than reskins of existing content in game, if that's up your alley, any donation would motivate me greatly to make more innovative mods/improve existing mods! If you aren't comfortable donating/can't afford to do so(which is completely fine), sharing and letting others know of the mods will help greatly as well! Cheers!
